page.overview:
Who is Callow Batta?

Callow Batta was a university teacher and a pirate.

Initially a Coruscant-born college professor of governmental and political history at the University of Sanbra, Batta kept the job for almost 20 years. A Wookiee friend gave him a Wartaki clay pipe that he since used to smoke.

Due to his occasional anti-Imperial lectures, the Moff of Sanbra sector decided to put Batta on "indefinite leave" on 1 ABY, without giving any official reason. The balding professor, although a bit overweight, was still in good health, and considered it a chance to begin a new career.

He decided to became a thief, pirate and smuggler with some unidentified partners that were believed to be other ex-academics. He raided two Galaxy Tours Cruisers (on Yuga 2 and Torch sector), and many other ships in the Alui Corridor. However, he was known to never have physically harmed any of his victims—and to provide fizzer-sweets to children.
